sourceDecision: Retain production. compareValues accepts unknown operands and declares text/ascending defaults. It binds first = scalar(a, kind) and second = scalar(b, kind). Its null-result conditional return precedes the order binding and final direction expression. The numeric alternative declares typeof first === "number" && typeof second === "number" ? first - second; the final return declares direction === "asc" ? order : -order. The array alternative and natural.compare fallback are adjacent declaration context only, not re-evaluated parsing or collation. These declarations establish no evaluated scalar results, numeric values, subtraction precision, signed-zero/overflow/equality/stability or runtime ordering.
